Seven short documentaries turn their cameras on the rituals – sacred and everyday – that hold Irish communities together. Across faith, friendship, and tradition, each film finds something universal in the small and specific. The programme has been curated from the Galway Film Fleadh Programme 2026 by Declan McSteen.

Relic – Sam Howard
The Biddy – The Kerry Collective
Bowling Roads – Laura Mahler
Blackrock – Normagh Heaney & Jessie Green
I Didn’t Want To Be Here – Fionnuala McCormack
My Friend, Kev – Colin Peppard
Pigeon Catcher – Yifan Wen

An audience prize, supported by Screen Scene, will be awarded for best film in this programme.

F-RATED.
